sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored Local: GGUF Quants + llama.cpp
sources.snippet: To run Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored locally, pull the gated GGUF repo orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-GGUF from Hugging Face, pick a quant by your VRAM — Q4_K_M (16.8 GB) for a 24 GB GPU, IQ4_XS (15.3 GB) for a 16 GB GPU, Q3_K_M (13.5 GB) when you want context headroom — and serve it with a current llama.cpp build using the --jinja flag, adding --mmproj if you need vision. sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-GGUF: Image-to-Text model - aimodels.fyi
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-GGUF is a GGUF-quantized version of Alibaba's 27-billion-parameter Qwen3.8-27B model with safety alignment removed through abliteration. Built and maintained by orcarouter, this model runs on CPU and GPU via llama.cpp with quantization options ranging from 2-bit to 16-bit precision.
